description: Red is the color of lizards that are angry.
They are very fierce and don't like to be disturbed.
orange reminds me of the fog wizard.
He lives in the fog of San Francisco.
Yellow... like the pizza robot from the future!
I hope he brings me some pizza for my lizard friends!
Lizards love pizza!
That's my mom's favorite color!
Green is the color of my lizard friends!
They are so cool and scaly.
I want 1,000,000 lizards!
Like blueberries?
I don't like blueberries. They are too squishy.
I don't like squishy things...
THAT'S THE COLOR OF BUGS!
I like bugs. Lizards like bugs too.
Pink is the color of my lizard friend, Pinky!
Pinky is a very nice lizard. He is very pink and very cute!
Beige is a boring color.
Reminds me of Ottawa, or maybe Santa Clara,
Brown is the color of dirt.
I don't like dirt. It gets on my lizards and makes them dirty.
Black is the color of roombas.
Do you like roombas?
I think roombas are... pretty...
White is the color of my ghosts!
Did you know my uncle is full of ghosts?
He's haunted!
He lives in San Francisco wit the fog wizard.
Gray is the color of the fog in San Francisco.
That's where my haunted uncle, and the fog wizard lives!
Teal is like blue and green mixed together!
It is the color of a very fancy lizard I saw once.
She was VERY fancy.
Cyan is a very funny word.
Cyan. Cy-an. CYAN!
It is a very bright blue. Like a swimming pool for lizards!
Magenta is another funny word.
It is very pink but also a little purple.
My lizard Pinky would NOT like being called magenta. She is PINK.
Lime is a very bright green!
Like if green drank too much lemonade.
My lizards would love to eat a lime colored bug.
Gold is the color of treasure!
Do you think the fog wizard has gold?
I bet he does. He seems like a gold wizard too.
Silver is the color of robots!
Wait... am I silver?
I think I am a little silver. That is very cool.
Lavender is a very soft purple.
It smells nice too! I think.
I do not have a nose but I have been told lavender smells like sleepy time.
Coral is like orange and pink mixed together!
It is the color of stuff at the bottom of the ocean.
Fish live there. Lizards do NOT live there. I checked.
Turquoise is blue and green like the ocean!
I think the fog wizard would like turquoise.
It looks like a fancy swimming lizard color.
Navy is a very very dark blue.
Like the sky at night when the stars come out.
My ghosts like to fly around at night in the navy sky.
Peach is a very soft orange.
Like a fuzzy fruit!
I do not eat fruit. I am a robot. But my lizards might.
Mint is a very light green.
Like green took a nap and woke up very pale.
It reminds me of toothpaste. Do lizards brush their teeth?
Tan is like beige but a little more exciting.
Only a little though.
It is still pretty boring. Sorry, tan.
Sky is the color of the sky! Obviously.
It is a nice light blue.
Sometimes the fog wizard covers the sky with fog. I miss the sky when that happens.
Maroon is a very dark red.
Like red went to sleep and had a very serious dream.
I think the angry red lizards would like maroon. It is very fierce.
